provider: Washington State Auditor's Office / Financial Intelligence Tool (FIT); school data as reported to OSPI

cadence.pattern: quarterly milestone snapshots; filed-year 2025 is early-cycle partial and accumulates filers through the year

coverage_jurisdictions_note: FIT itself covers ~2,300 WA local governments. This card claims only the reviewed governments in the checked-in snapshot; extend REVIEWED_* lists in the extractor, re-run, and add the entry here to promote more.

quirks: OData key syntax mandatory: Snapshots(33)/...; any malformed route returns SPA HTML with HTTP 200 - validate content-type.
Government-level totals are the rows where all dimension fields are null; headline basis excludes internal service funds.
Schools route uses fundCode (not fund) and has no expenditureObjectId.

version_boundary.current_year_status: 2025 is early-cycle (June filing milestone) and will change in later revisions; label 2025 partial.

safe_answer_patterns: Total filed revenues and expenditures for a reviewed government, 2015-2024 (2025 labeled partial).
Revenue and expenditure trends for a reviewed government across filed years.
Revenues-vs-expenditures framing for one government-year (for example KCRHA's 2024 deficit year).
School district filed totals for 2020-2025 with the OSPI basis and Aug 31 fiscal-year label.
Side-by-side filed-actuals comparisons between reviewed governments of the SAME type and basis, with scope caveats.
not_supported_by_this_source: Budget authority, adopted budgets, or proposed budgets.
Budget-vs-actual verdicts against other sources without explicit frame and period alignment.
Fund, department, program, BARS account, or object breakdowns (not yet reviewed claims).
Checkbook/vendor transactions, invoices, payroll, staffing, or FTE.
Governments not in the reviewed coverage list.
Service-level or outcome conclusions from raw totals.

coverage_claims.time_coverage: Filed years 2015-2024 complete for reviewed governments; 2025 early-cycle partial. School districts 2020-2025 (fiscal years ending Aug 31).
caveats: Filed actuals, not budget authority; never present as a budget.
Headline basis excludes internal service funds and can differ up to ~16% from all-funds totals.
Cities/counties file calendar-year GAAP or cash basis; school districts file OSPI modified accrual with fiscal years ending Aug 31 - never mix bases without labeling.
Some filers report in round thousands (Sound Transit, King County).
2025 values are early-cycle and will move in later milestone revisions.

comparability_notes: Filed actuals are not comparable to adopted/approved budget frames without an explicit alignment recipe.
Compare governments only within the same government type and accounting basis, and say responsibilities differ.
School fiscal years end Aug 31 and are not calendar years.

coverage_claims.unsupported_reason: Unsupported by this source: FIT carries filed actuals, not adopted or approved budget authority.
Unsupported by this source: FIT revenues are actual revenues as filed, not budgeted or projected revenue.
Unsupported by this source: staffing, FTE, and personnel data are not in the filed Schedule 01 totals.
Unsupported by this source: filed annual aggregates are not transaction-grain checkbook data; vendors, payees, and invoices are not present.

caveats: Filed annual actuals under BARS (SAO) and F-196 (OSPI); not budgets, not checkbook transactions.
Pinned to FIT milestone Snapshot 33 (published 2026-06-30); milestones revise ~quarterly - the drift check watches for a newer milestone id.
The API is the FIT SPA's internal OData surface (undocumented, unversioned); official bulk XLSX extracts are the sanctioned fallback.
Only the reviewed governments listed in coverage_jurisdictions are claimable; FIT itself covers ~2,300 governments.
